title: How to Secure Your Home When Kids Go Back to School
summary: School's back in session — is your home protected during the day? Here are some home security tips to help you get set up.
body_markdown:
With summer over, your house is likely far less busy during the day than it was before. You’re off at work, the kids are off at school, leaving pets and other family members alone in the house — or leaving your house completely empty. That clockwork schedule creates a new opportunity for thieves to strike.


Securing your home during the school year means figuring out how your family’s departure and arrival times overlap so you can keep track of everything going on at the house. For example, if you work during the day, your kids will likely be home before you are. Meanwhile, package deliveries show up during the day when no one is available to receive them, meaning they’re left on the porch to potentially get snatched by porch pirates.


That’s where your video doorbell comes in. Setting up a security camera like the[Arlo Video Doorbell](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-doorbell) to watch over the main entryway of your house allows you to see exactly who is coming, who is going, and when they show up or leave. Programming customized alerts via your security camera app will provide more specific information regarding who’s showing up, giving you a better chance at checking the feed or responding via 2-Way Audio if you need. They’ll help you give your kids a message at the front door when they arrive, notify delivery drivers where to hide packages, or do whatever you need to do to keep the front door safe, even if you’re not at home.
